about: A monthly check of rows only a model has read (T1, since 2026-12). Each month scripts/model_sample.py picks 20 such rows at random, and each is marked agree or disagree with what the model recorded (the summary, patterns and primitives against the cited file). Since 2026-11-05 the weekly upkeep makes the check with a second model reading, recorded as "checker": "model"; a person's check says "checker": "person".

Agreeing is not reading the call site: evidence.read_on is set only when a person says they read the file, never from a model's check. docs/status.md prints the latest month's count and who checked it. Validated by python3 scripts/model_sample.py --check.
